crossRefs.note: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary…
Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
When Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and…
Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body, and shed out his…
Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is…
His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Hail, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

translations.web: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.
translations.bsb: Their tongues are deadly arrows; they speak deception. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.
translations.kjv: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
translations.asv: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart he layeth wait for him.
